title: The call that weathered ages
intro: Imagine a soul who stood alone against an entire civilization, determined to guide them back from misguidance with unwavering resolve. For centuries, the message was rejected, mocked, and dismissed—yet the effort never ceased. Eventually, a great reckoning came, and only a few boarded salvation alongside this steadfast soul. Can you identify this figure from the Quran?
clues: I was sent as a warner to a people lost in their own ways.
I invited them to seek forgiveness and turn back from their wrongs, but they turned away.
Under divine command, I constructed a massive vessel while my people watched and ridiculed me.
I called upon my Lord ceaselessly—eventually He responded, and water poured from the sky in torrents.
I boarded the vessel with those who believed when the floodwaters rose above the land.
I cried out to one who had stayed behind, asking them to take refuge on a mountain, but the decree had already passed.
